# Community & Maintenance

Release cadence, contribution process, governance, and roadmap visibility.
See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## Governance

PatternFly is "sponsored and maintained by Red Hat, but is open to all" [11].
Red Hat is the copyright holder (2014-2025) [13].

**No formal governance document** (GOVERNANCE.md) was found [13]. Decision-making
is informal and collaborative: contributors comment on issues, and "a member of
our team will reach out with next steps" [13]. No formal voting or approval
procedures are documented [13].

The design team is "composed of visual and interaction designers" working in
agile sprints with GitHub project boards [13].

## License

MIT [11][18].

### Minor Releases (Quarterly)

| 6.0.0 | October 2024 [16] |
| 6.2 | April 2025 [4] |
| 6.3 | July 2025 [4] |

Approximately quarterly minor releases based on the observed pattern. No
PF 6.1 release was found — it may have been skipped or incorporated into 6.2.

## Version Support Policy

PatternFly supports the "2 most recent major versions" [41]. When PatternFly 6
released, PatternFly 4 support ceased. No formal LTS model or documented
end-of-life dates were found.

## Contribution Process

Open to everyone: "We depend on community contributions to help our design
system grow and evolve. We encourage everyone, regardless of background, to
get involved" [13].

Contribution areas [13]:
- Feature ideas → GitHub Discussions (feature-requests category) [12]
- Bug reports → GitHub issues
- Documentation updates
- Design work (visual and interaction)
- Code development (HTML/CSS and React)

Dedicated Slack channels: patternfly-design, patternfly-core, patternfly-react [13].

## Roadmap Visibility

A public roadmap repository exists at github.com/patternfly/pf-roadmap [41],
with a Feature Roadmap project board. Release highlights on the website serve
as a retrospective changelog [4]. No forward-looking public roadmap document
was found in fetched sources.

## Migration Tooling

66 ESLint-based codemods for PF5→PF6 migration [17], run via:
```
npx @patternfly/pf-codemods@latest <path> --v6 --fix
```

Community support for migration available via Slack [16].
